scientific_queries.note: Resource audit plus an external descriptive test on a locally held published dataset.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the amendment documents the false dichotomy and the result is a descriptive external check with explicit design limits.

new_resource.name: GDSC combination screen (Jaaks 2022 figshare), locally held, no download

decisions.false_dichotomy_note: the 0.50 variance-share threshold had no theoretical basis and compressed a continuous fact into a wrong opposition; reliability was 0.904

headline: synergy has a stable, highly reproducible combination-level component (30% of variance, split-half 0.90, 19x the permutation null), yet within-combination cell-to-cell variation (sd 0.044) is larger than between-combination variation (sd 0.032)
scope_change: the standing 'unseen drug is untestable' verdict now applies to BATCHIE only; GDSC has 65 drugs and supports a leave-one-drug-out test, which this round did not run
